sql_templates.description: Retrieve latest FII/DII flows, market regime, breadth, and index data.
sql_templates.name: combined_market_review
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_data AS (
    SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS max_date FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
)
SELECT 
    flow.trade_date, 
    flow.fii_net_today, 
    flow.dii_net_today, 
    flow.flow_signal, 
    reg.regime, 
    reg.confidence, 
    breadth.advances, 
    breadth.declines, 
    breadth.ad_signal, 
    index_data.close, 
    index_data.trend_signal
FROM signals.fii_dii_flows AS flow
JOIN signals.regime_history AS reg ON flow.trade_date = reg.trade_date
JOIN breadth.market_daily AS breadth ON flow.trade_date = breadth.trade_date
JOIN market.index_eod AS index_data ON flow.trade_date = index_data.trade_date
AND index_data.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
WHERE flow.trade_date = (SELECT max_date FROM latest_data);

synthesis_guidance: ['Summarize market context using regime, flow, breadth, and index information.', 'Focus on identifying if the market is in a risk-on or risk-off state.']
